name: korean-quiz-videos
description: Phase 1: a local Korean quiz video rendered with Remotion.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/question-timing.test.mjs tests/quiz-schema.test.mjs tests/quiz-timeline.test.mjs tests/render-cli.test.mjs tests/media-inspection.test.mjs tests/assets-preview.test.mjs tests/romanization.test.mjs tests/ending-modes.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && remotion bundle src/index.ts build
scripts.inspect: remotion ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height,pix_fmt,avg_frame_rate,nb_frames:format=duration,size -of json out/korean-sample.mp4
scripts.render:question: remotion render src/index.ts CafeQuestion out/cafe-question.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --crf=18 --concurrency=2
scripts.inspect:question: remotion ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height,pix_fmt,avg_frame_rate,nb_frames:format=duration,size -of json out/cafe-question.mp4
